raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43115.

When a Flux conditioning has no `pooled_output`, ComfyUI calls the DiT with `y=None`, and its native Flux zero-fills `y`. `FluxAdapter.pack` passed it through as `pooled_embeds=[None]`, so on the worker `prepare_pos_cond_kwargs` handed `pooled_projections=None` to `time_text_embed`:

```
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'dtype'
```

The cond was also never cached, since `_cond_key` needs `prompt_embeds[0]` to be a tensor.

**Depends on #43109, please merge that first.** This branch is stacked on it (the first two commits are #43109). With a zero-filled `y` the cond gets a cache key, and on main's old shape + first/last-scalar key every y-less cond would get the same key (zeros everywhere), so the second prompt, or the CFG negative, would silently reuse the first one's T5 context. I checked this: the new session test fails with this commit on top of main's key.

## Modifications

- `FluxAdapter.pack`: if `y is None`, use `torch.zeros(batch, 768)` with the context's dtype/device, like `comfy/ldm/flux/model.py`. 768 is Flux.1's CLIP-L width (`pooled_projection_dim`); `FluxAdapter` only handles `model_type="flux"`.
- Tests: `test_flux_pack_zero_fills_missing_pooled` (pack + the real `CombinedTimestepGuidanceTextProjEmbeddings`), `test_cond_key_flux_without_pooled_keeps_t5_apart` (two y-less conds with different T5 stay apart, a repeat still hits the cache).

## Accuracy Tests

CPU end-to-end repro: real ComfyUI KSampler (ComfyUI master 58b176f) with the plugin's `FluxExecutor` + `SGLDModelPatcher`, a cond with no `pooled_output`, and the worker half in-process (real `bind_comfyui_session` -> `FluxPipelineConfig.prepare_pos_cond_kwargs` -> the DiT's `time_text_embed`):

```
before: CRASH after 0 DiT calls: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'dtype'
after:  OK: 4 DiT calls, time_text_embed out (1, 64), cond key set on 4/4 calls
```

GPU: not run. I set up a 2-GPU sanity run (FLUX.1-dev in comfyui mode, the plugin's `test_flux_pipeline.py` plus the real `FluxExecutor` with `y=None` compared against an explicit zero `y`), but it sat in the queue for 2x L40S for about 50 minutes and never started, so I stopped it. Happy to run it if someone can trigger GPU CI.

Unit tests (CPU):

```
before fix: 2 failed, 21 passed   test_comfyui_{adapters,session}.py
after fix:  98 passed, 11 skipped (CUDA only), 3 xfailed   test_comfyui_{session,adapters,h3,generator,profile}.py, test_conditioning_cache.py
            12 passed   apps/ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion/test/test_h3_request.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No change to the normal path. When `y` is missing, one `(B, 768)` zero tensor is allocated per call.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (not needed)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (CPU only, see above)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+def _hash_value(digest, value) -> None:
+    """Hash ``value`` into ``digest``, framing each item so values cannot merge."""
+    if torch.is_tensor(value):
+        tensor = value.detach().contiguous().cpu()
+        digest.update(f"T{tensor.dtype}{tuple(tensor.shape)}".encode())
+        digest.update(tensor.reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes())
+    elif isinstance(value, dict):
+        digest.update(f"D{len(value)}".encode())
+        for key, item in value.items():
+            _hash_value(digest, key)
+            _hash_value(digest, item)
+    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+        digest.update(f"L{len(value)}".encode())
+        for item in value:
+            _hash_value(digest, item)
+    else:
+        text = repr(value).encode()
+        digest.update(f"V{len(text)}:".encode())
+        digest.update(text)

+    ex.send(packed(ref_a))
+    second = ex.send(packed(ref_b))
+    assert torch.equal(second.image_latent, ref_b)
+    release_comfyui_session(ex.sid)
+
+
+def test_cond_key_repeat_still_uses_cache() -> None:
+    ex = _Executor(FluxAdapter())
+    x, t = torch.zeros(1, 16, 8, 8), torch.tensor([0.5])
+    y, ctx = torch.randn(1, 768), torch.randn(1, 8, 4096)
+    ex.send(ex.adapter.pack(x, t, ctx, y=y))
+    # ComfyUI hands over fresh tensors each step; equal content must still hit.
+    repeat = ex.adapter.pack(x, t, ctx.clone(), y=y.clone())
+    restored = ex.send(repeat)
+    assert repeat.prompt_embeds == []
+    assert torch.equal(restored.prompt_embeds[1], ctx)
+    release_comfyui_session(ex.sid)
+
+
+def _h3_packed(text, payload):
+    return PackedForward(
+        latents=torch.zeros(1, 4, 2, 2),
+        timesteps=torch.tensor([500.0]),
+        prompt_embeds=[text],
+        prompt_seq_lens=[[int(text.shape[0])]],
+        height=2,
+        width=2,
+        extra_req={
+            "h3_payload": payload,
+            "h3_context": text,
+            "comfyui_cache_fp": {"spatial": (1, 2, 2)},
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def test_h3_cache_hit_restores_own_extras() -> None:
+    ex = _Executor(MiniMaxH3Adapter())
+    pos, neg = torch.ones(3, 4), torch.zeros(3, 4)
+    pos_payload, neg_payload = {"text_token_tags": [1, 2]}, {"text_token_tags": [3]}
+    ex.send(_h3_packed(pos, pos_payload))
+    ex.send(_h3_packed(neg, neg_payload))
+    later_pos = _h3_packed(pos.clone(), dict(pos_payload))
+    restored = ex.send(later_pos)
+    assert "h3_context" not in later_pos.extra_req  # cache hit, extras dropped
+    assert torch.equal(restored.extra["h3_context"], pos)
+    assert restored.extra["h3_payload"] == pos_payload
+    release_comfyui_session(ex.sid)
+
+
+def test_h3_same_text_different_payload_not_conflated() -> None:
+    ex = _Executor(MiniMaxH3Adapter())
+    text = torch.ones(3, 4)
+    ex.send(_h3_packed(text, {"refs": [torch.zeros(2, 2)]}))
+    second = ex.send(_h3_packed(text.clone(), {"refs": [torch.ones(2, 2)]}))
+    assert torch.equal(second.extra["h3_payload"]["refs"][0], torch.ones(2, 2))
+    release_comfyui_session(ex.sid)
+
+
+def test_cond_key_hashes_large_tensors_inside_lists() -> None:
+    ex = _Executor(MiniMaxH3Adapter())
+    text = torch.ones(3, 4)
+    latent_a = torch.zeros(4096)
+    latent_b = latent_a.clone()
+    latent_b[2048] = 1.0  # outside what repr() would print
+    key_a = ex._cond_key(_h3_packed(text, {"cond_video_latents": [latent_a]}))
+    key_b = ex._cond_key(_h3_packed(text, {"cond_video_latents": [latent_b]}))
+    assert key_a != key_b
+
+
+def test_extras_cached_per_cond_key() -> None:
+    sid = "exec4:1"
+    pos_ctx, neg_ctx = torch.ones(2, 4), torch.zeros(2, 4)
+    for key, ctx in (("pos", pos_ctx), ("neg", neg_ctx)):
+        req = _Req()
+        req.extra = {
+            "comfyui_session_id": sid,
+            "comfyui_cond_key": key,
+            "h3_context": ctx,
+        }
+        req.prompt_embeds = [ctx]
+        bind_comfyui_session(req)
+
+    later_pos = _Req()
+    later_pos.extra = {"comfyui_session_id": sid, "comfyui_cond_key": "pos"}
+    bind_comfyui_session(later_pos)
+    assert torch.equal(later_pos.extra["h3_context"], pos_ctx)
+    release_comfyui_session(sid)
+
+
+def test_cond_key_flux_without_pooled_keeps_t5_apart() -> None:
+    ex = _Executor(FluxAdapter())
+    x, t = torch.zeros(1, 16, 8, 8), torch.tensor([0.5])
+    ctx_a, ctx_b = torch.randn(1, 8, 4096), torch.randn(1, 8, 4096)
+    first = ex.send(ex.adapter.pack(x, t, ctx_a, y=None))
+    second = ex.send(ex.adapter.pack(x, t, ctx_b, y=None))
+    assert torch.equal(first.prompt_embeds[1], ctx_a)
+    assert torch.equal(second.prompt_embeds[1], ctx_b)
+    repeat = ex.adapter.pack(x, t, ctx_a.clone(), y=None)
+    restored = ex.send(repeat)
+    assert repeat.prompt_embeds == []  # cached now that y is a tensor
+    assert torch.equal(restored.prompt_embeds[1], ctx_a)
+    release_comfyui_session(ex.sid)
+
+
 class _FakePipeline:
     def __init__(self):
         self.modules = {}

Fix LGTM. 
test_flux_pack_zero_fills_missing_pooled fails on machines with CUDA. The JIT timestep_embedding kernel rejects the test's CPU tensors (Tensor match failed ... device=cpu). Please run it on cuda when available, or stub the embedding. Also conflicts with #43163 in the test files.

Fixed: the embedding step in test_flux_pack_zero_fills_missing_pooled now runs on CUDA when available. Also moved the new tests so they no longer collide with #43163 in the test files (merge is clean now). Adapters + session tests pass on an L40S on Modal.
Superseded by #43490, which consolidates this fix with 3 other FluxAdapter fixes (#43487) per maintainer request to reduce PR overhead. Closing.
